gate_text: LOYO BSS comparison; tournament-only (500-600 games) vs blended (2200). Flagged 04-01; never run.

headline.statistical_significance: p=0.036 at α=0.05 uncorrected; NOT significant under Bonferroni across 4 configs (α=0.0125)

comparison_to_blended_stacked.note: Blended+stacked was the other arm of the council gate. Direct matched-LOYO run never produced, but MEMORY.md §2 D1 aggregates the finding for that regime class across LightGBM, XGBoost, SpreadRegressor, 27-feature ensemble + LightGBM stacking: BSS = 0 vs seed baseline across 17 yrs. Tournament-only simple_7 (+4.8%) is directionally better than blended+stacked (0%), consistent with the MEMORY.md §1 lesson "7-feature logistic is the ceiling given data constraints".

effect_on_pivot.verdict: Does NOT re-open the 2026-04-02 pivot (§3 row 7).
effect_on_pivot.reasoning: Finding is directionally positive but marginal: uncorrected p=0.036, Bonferroni-corrected fails. 14-yr backtest power is 9-16% per §1 Validation ("Use them for binary/directional claims, not to tune parameter values"). A 5% BSS improvement also does not change the pool-EV argument that drove the pivot: pool optimization is the right axis of improvement, not prediction accuracy.
